name: DaBai Max
summary: DaBai Max is an Orbbec active-stereo structured-light depth camera for service-robot navigation and obstacle avoidance. It provides onboard depth processing and USB connectivity for embedded perception. Its wide field of view targets nearby obstacles and environmental sensing.
